events.land-of-gods: Six Straw Hats end up in the mysterious Land of the Gods.
events.luffy-meets-loki: Luffy meets Loki, the chained accursed prince.
events.shamrock-shanks-twin: Shamrock, commander of the Knights of God, is Shanks's twin.
events.harley-reveal: The ancient story of the Harley is told.
events.luffy-vs-scopper-gaban: Luffy faces Scopper Gaban, a former Roger Pirate.
events.knights-of-god-attack: The Knights of God attack Elbaph to kidnap the giant children.
events.gaban-vs-sommers: Gaban beheads Sommers in a single second.
events.imu-domi-reversi: Imu possesses Gunko and uses Domi Reversi.
events.rocks-pirates-formed: Rocks forms his crew after clashing with King Harald.
events.rocks-vs-harald: Rocks and Harald fight to a draw.
events.rocks-demon-transformation: Imu turns Rocks into a demon.
events.garp-roger-defeat-rocks: Garp and Roger defeat Rocks with combined Conqueror's Haki.
events.loki-eats-legendary-fruit: Loki eats Elbaph's legendary fruit with Ragnir's help.
events.loki-kills-harald: Loki kills Harald, who is controlled by Imu.
events.loki-nidhoggr: The transformed Loki flies alongside Luffy in Gear 5.
events.luffy-loki-defeat-sommers: Luffy and Loki bring down Sommers.
events.imu-descends-elbaph: Nerona Imu descends to Elbaph in person.
events.loki-vs-imu: Loki faces Imu in his Nidhoggr form.
events.brook-esperia-past: Brook's past in the Kingdom of Esperia and Princess Shuri.
events.luffy-vs-imu: Luffy enters the fight against Imu.
events.imu-identity-reveal: Gaban reveals Imu's identity to Luffy.
events.dawn-thor-bullet: Luffy and Loki pierce Imu's shield with Dawn Thor Bullet.
events.zoro-conquerors-haki-sommers: Zoro masters his Conqueror's Haki in his swords and overcomes Sommers's immortality.
